text:
marina: alert: p99 gateway timeouts + 5xx spike in hosted-infer-west1, customers reporting errors. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/infer/west1 (SLO alarm id: SLO-3890)
kevin: seeing it too — spike starts ~11:42 UTC, p50 fine, tail jump. lots of 502/504 and connection resets.
sre-bot: triggered rule infra.gateway.errors.p99 > 1.1s for 5m, eval window 5m, severity: high
sam: customer-relay says repeated "upstream reset" in logs, attaching sample below
sam: ```
2026-03-16T11:43:12Z gateway[proxy-3] "POST /v1/generate" 502 upstream_reset host=infer-west1 backend=batch-v2-7
2026-03-16T11:43:13Z gateway[proxy-5] "POST /v1/generate" 504 read_timeout host=infer-west1
```
marina: good — logs show two error modes. query I ran:
marina: `logs query "service:gateway env:prod region:west1 status:5xx | count() by backend, status" | sort -desc`
kevin: traces are weird — start span from client->gateway exists, but child spans to batcher often missing during spike. looks like trace context dropped after header size growth.
support: escalated from support: customer acme-models (id: C-1123) hit 10 errors in last 5m, provided error id 3890-ACM-11. they're on Dedicated->Hosted migration.
sam: quick repro curl we ran (repeatable from our internal repro):
sam: ```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"ggml-batched-v2","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":512}' -i
# response: 502 Bad Gateway (upstream reset)
```
jordan: hypothesis: batcher v2 memory pressure + large prefix KV cache causing backpressure and then proxy timeouts. also possibly header growth from metadata causing trace headers to be dropped.
kevin: rolling back batcher v2 -> batcher v1 in west1 now, will watch. ETA 6m.
marina: temp mitigation: increase gateway upstream timeout to 60s for infer route, and reduce default batch size to 8 (can we push that config?)
kevin: pushed rollback, config applied. p99 latency down a bit, 5xx count decreasing.
marina: action items: (1) eng-runtime to investigate KV cache growth under long prompts (jordan) (2) add guard to drop oversized trace headers instead of failing (kevin) (3) support to follow up with customer C-1123 and share error ids (support) (4) add a dashboard panel for header_size distribution and trace-child-drop rate (marina)
support: noted, pinging the customer and opening a ticket. :white_check_mark:
jordan: I'll capture heap/local metrics for batcher v2 and run repro with heavy metadata headers. posting results in this thread.
kevin: keeping watch; will escalate if 5xx > 0.5% on proxied traffic again. :eyes:
marina: thanks team. will convert to postmortem if we get a sustained SLO hit. dropping probe to 1m sampling for traces in west1 for next 2h to improve coverage.
